data.Title: 20692 - Snow Removal Services for Kings Beach Benefit Assessment District
data.Description: Placer County is seeking bids for snow removal services for the Kings Beach Benefit Assessment District. The areas generally require the removal of snow from sidewalks and public building entrances, including ADA ramps and stairways.  This work includes hand shoveling, and the use of small rubber tire or rubber track snow removal equipment (metal track equipment and chains are NOT allowed to be used). All work and bid prices are subject to Prevailing wages.

data.Title: 20685 - Wastewater, Water & Solid Waste Systems Consulting Services
data.Description: The County of Placer is requesting sealed Statements of Qualifications from qualified individuals or firms to provide consulting services for the Department of Public Works, Environmental Engineering Division for Wastewater, Water & Solid Waste Systems Consulting Services (6 service categories) at various locations in unincorporated Placer County.  This Request for Qualifications will result in a Qualified Lists of firms assigned to up to 6 service disciplines.

data.Title: 20684 - Preparation of Environmental Impact Reports (EIR)
data.Description:
The County of Placer is seeking Statements of Qualifications (SOQ) from qualified firms for the preparation of Environmental Impact Reports (EIRs). The Placer County Environmental Review Ordinance requires that EIRs prepared for private and public projects must be prepared by consultants under contract to Placer County.  This provision is mandatory for all projects.  The County enters into three-party contracts with the Consultant and the applicant for the preparation of such EIRs.  The County will negotiate and enter into a contract directly with the Consultant for the preparation of EIRs for projects undertaken by the County.
 

The purpose of this Request for Qualifications (RFQ) is to establish a Qualified List of firms for the preparation of EIRs.  Qualified firms will be selected based on qualifications in accordance with the provisions of this RFQ.  The resulting list will be valid for a period of three (3) years from the date of award with an option to renew for two additional one-year periods.

data.Title: 20676 - Foresthill Divide Community Protection Project Environmental Compliance Project
data.Description:
Placer County's Department of Agriculture, Parks, and Natural Resources' Regional Forest Health (RFH) Division has been awarded Congressional funding to implement the Foresthill Divide Community Protection Project Planning and Environmental Compliance Services. This project is designed to evaluate wildfire risk on over 50,014 acres of non-federal forest and wildland-urban interface (WUI) lands in Placer County, develop a detailed treatment plan for forest resilience activities, and complete environmental review on one or more priority sub-areas to expedite implementation of fuels reduction treatments.

To fulfill the goals of this grant, the County is seeking a qualified individual or firm to serve as the prime consultant and complete all services and materials necessary to advance the Project, including CEQA coordination and landowner engagement, biological and cultural resource surveys, data analysis and CEQA documentation, forestry treatment planning, and fire modeling and GIS analysis. The selected contractor may subcontract specialized tasks but will serve as the single point of accountability to the County.

 A key focus of this contract is to position priority sub-areas, including the Foresthill Divide Community Protection Project (FHDCPP) and other priority areas within the planning footprint, for expedited implementation of fuels reduction treatments under subsequent phases.  This includes completing CEQA documentation under both CEQA Notice(s) of Exemption and the 2019 California Vegetation Treatment Program (CalVTP) Programmatic Environmental Impact Report, developing detailed treatment designs, and preparing all plans and approvals needed to facilitate a seamless transition to implementation.

data.Title: 20646 - Psychiatric Health Facility (PHF) Services
data.Description:
The County of Placer is soliciting proposals from experienced and qualified organizations to operate one or both of the County’s 16-bed Psychiatric Health Facilities (PHF). 

This RFP will result in the award of contracts to one or more firms. The initial term for these services will be for approximately one (1) year, with an option to renew for six (6) additional one-year periods, at the County’s discretion.

data.Title: 20678 - Construction Management, Inspection, Materials Testing, Surveying, and Related Services
data.Description: The County of Placer is soliciting sealed Statements of Qualifications from qualified engineering firms to provide construction management, construction inspection, materials testing, construction surveying, and related services for various projects.  These services will encompass serving as the County's Representative to the Construction Contractor and the public with regard to activities at the construction site, interpretation of the requirements of the Construction Contract Documents, assessing the acceptability of the Contractor's work, material testing, managing the construction project, and evaluating Contractor's claims.

data.Title: 20673 - Managed Security Operations Center
data.Description:
The County of Placer is soliciting proposals from qualified firms to provide Managed Cyber Security Operations Center (SOC) Services. To improve the County’s information security posture, the Information Technology Department (ITD) needs increased visibility into activity within cloud-based and on-premises information technology environments. Timely detection of malicious cyber activity and potential cyberattacks is critical to preventing or minimizing the impact of cyberincidents to the County of Placer’s technology environment and information assets. Increases to the volume and sophistication of modern cyber attacks have identified the necessity for 24x7 cybersecurity monitoring and response. 

This RFP will result in the award of a contract to be effective for an initial term of approximately two (2) years, with an option to renew the contract for two additional one-year periods, at the County’s discretion.  It is anticipated that the selected proposer will begin service as quickly as possible after award of the contract.
